AI Finds New Treatment Path for Rare Disease
Ackman on Wednesday shared a 2025 New York Times report on
about a 37-year-old man with POEMS syndrome, a rare blood disorder, whose condition had deteriorated to the point that he was being sent to hospice.

An AI system analyzed thousands of existing medicines and identified a combination that no one had previously tried for his condition. The patient reportedly responded within a week and later went into remission following a stem cell transplant.
"Incredible," Ackman wrote while sharing the report.

The case highlights one potential application of AI in medicine — drug repurposing, where existing medicines are analyzed for possible uses against diseases they were not originally developed to treat.
